# ZOE — account brief

## Who
ZOE runs personalized nutrition programs built on science, with at-home testing and daily guidance in the app ([joinzoe.com](https://joinzoe.com/)). The company operates the joinzoe GitHub org ([github.com](https://github.com/joinzoe)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json is present in joinzoe/zoe-app ([github.com](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/eas.json))
- react-native 0.74.5 in joinzoe/zoe-app/package.json ([github.com](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json))
- CI workflows in joinzoe/zoe-app ([github.com](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- joinzoe/zoe-app last pushed 2026-08-17 ([github.com](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app))
- 16 public repos and 88 followers on github.com/joinzoe ([github.com](https://github.com/joinzoe))
- 22,000 App Store ratings ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982))
- 8 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982))
- GitHub org description names a regulated category ("health") ([github.com](https://github.com/joinzoe))

## Why now
The app shipped 8 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)). The repo was pushed as recently as 2026-08-17 and runs react-native 0.74.5 ([github.com](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app)) ([github.com](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
I saw zoe-app has an eas.json checked in ([github.com](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/eas.json)) and GitHub Actions workflows in the same repo ([github.com](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)). You have also shipped 8 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)). At that cadence, how are you handling the split between full store builds and over-the-air updates in your release pipeline?
